programme.title: When Your Bff Is Leaving School
programme.desc: The bittersweet countdown: the late chats, the “let’s do something memorable” mood, packing up memories, and the quiet fear of “will things be the same after you go?”

programme.title: If Your Wife Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A husband’s internal monologue meets the reality of his wife apparently reading his mind—every unspoken thought becomes a comedic disaster waiting to happen.

programme.title: School Best Friends During Lockdown
programme.desc: Online classes, missed canteen gossip, and the nostalgia of school friendships during isolation.

programme.title: When Girls Fall For Red Flags
programme.desc: A witty portrayal of how girls knowingly ignore every warning sign in relationships, convincing themselves that red flags are just “misunderstood.”

programme.title: When He Doesn’t Like You Back
programme.desc: You think maybe he does, you hope he might, you plan how you’ll act—but deep down you always know: the answer might be “no”; the video shows the sting of un-reciprocated feelings and how you deal.

programme.title: When Your Sibling Comes Home After A Long Time
programme.desc: The excitement, the over-preparing, the sibling rivalry resurfacing, and the joy of rediscovering the quirks you’d missed while they were away.

programme.title: Break-Up Ke Stages
programme.desc: This video humorously explores the various emotional stages people go through after a breakup, depicting the struggles and eventual healing process. It shows the journey of moving on and attempting to cut contact, highlighting the complexities of post-breakup emotions.

programme.title: Love-Hate Relationship With Older Siblings
programme.desc: You fight, you compete, you annoy each other, you envy each other—but you also protect each other, share jokes, and there’s a lifelong bond underneath the push-and-pull.

programme.title: Silly Things We've All Heard In Our Childhood
programme.desc: Those repetitive warnings, superstitions, myths, and sayings older generations say (“don’t sit like that or you’ll get bald,” etc.). A nostalgic, funny look at how kids heard and internalized them.

programme.title: Struggles Of An Indian Bride
programme.desc: The emotional, logistical, and social pressures a bride faces — from family expectations to dress fittings, guest dramas, and internal doubts. The video underscores how “big day” dreams collide with reality.

programme.title: If Acp Pradyuman (cid) Were Your Boss
programme.desc: The video imagines ACP Pradyuman as a boss in an office setting. It highlights the dramatic style, quirky dialogues, and funny outcomes of his leadership.

programme.title: Neighbourhood Romance: Meeting Your Crush After A Long Time
programme.desc: The story follows two former childhood neighbors who cross paths after a long period of separation. As they reconnect, the video explores the awkward yet charming evolution of their relationship—moving from "childhood crushes" to young adults navigating modern life.

programme.title: Stuff Brothers And Sisters Do
programme.desc: The video is a montage of everyday moments that define the "Tom and Jerry" relationship most siblings share. It captures the transition from intense fighting over trivial things to being each other's biggest support system.

programme.title: Falling For Your Best Friend
programme.desc: The story explores the delicate and often painful realization that you've developed romantic feelings for the one person you can’t afford to lose—your best friend. It follows the emotional journey of two inseparable friends as they navigate the blurry line between platonic comfort and romantic attraction.

programme.title: Signs You Are Becoming Like Your Partner
programme.desc: The video follows a couple as they realize they are slowly losing their individual quirks and merging into a single unit. It captures those "Oh no, I’ve turned into you" moments that every long-term couple eventually faces.

programme.title: When Engineer Falls For Doctor
programme.desc: Two worlds collide: the methodical, formula-loving engineer and the empathetic, patient doctor—catching that awkward transition from friendly banter to “oh, wait I like you” and how they adjust and match.

programme.title: 8 Funny Things That Happen In A Father-Son Relationship
programme.desc: The video is a collection of relatable "micro-moments" that define the bond between a father and son. It captures the transition from a relationship based on authority to one based on friendship, albeit with the classic "dad" quirks remaining intact.

programme.title: Every Roadtrip Ever
programme.desc: The video captures the chaotic, funny, and predictable cycle of an Indian road trip with friends. It moves through the high expectations of the planning phase to the messy (but memorable) reality of actually being on the road.

programme.title: Annoying Things People Do In Your Car
programme.desc: The video is a comedic breakdown of the various ways passengers can drive a car owner (the "driver") absolutely crazy. It captures the struggle of trying to keep your car pristine while your friends treat it like a public lounge.

programme.title: Types Of Shoppers
programme.desc: The video humorously identifies and satirizes the various personas we all adopt the moment we step into a shopping center. It breaks down the stereotypes of shopping and, in classic FilterCopy fashion, flips the script on gendered expectations—showing that men can be just as obsessive or indecisive as women when it comes to fashion.

programme.title: Thoughts You Have While Studying
programme.desc: The video is a comedic dive into the brain of a student who is desperately trying to focus but is constantly derailed by distractions, procrastination, and existential dread. It perfectly captures the "pre-exam" struggle where everything in the world seems more interesting than the textbook in front of you.

programme.title: Backbenchers Vs Toppers
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the battle between disciplined Toppers and chaotic Backbenchers as a supernatural war. Inspired by Brahmastra, it turns exams and school life into a dramatic, high-stakes fight for ultimate power.

programme.title: Savage Millennial Vs Savage Gen Z
programme.desc: The video explores the generational divide through a series of "savage" exchanges between a Millennial (struggling to keep up) and a Gen Z protagonist (who seems to have a slang for everything). It highlights the hilarious friction that occurs when Millennial "hustle culture" meets Gen Z "boundaries."

programme.title: Life In Boy's School
programme.desc: The video is a high-energy, chaotic exploration of the "survival game" that is an all-boys school. It captures the specific brand of brotherhood, unfiltered humor, and lack of decorum that defines these institutions, moving away from typical co-ed romance to focus purely on the "bro" dynamic.

programme.title: People We See In Every Exam!
programme.desc: The video is a humorous "field guide" to the specific personalities you encounter in a high-pressure examination hall. It captures the frantic, sometimes absurd behavior of students during those three hours of "do or die" academic battle.

programme.title: What If Dhurandhar Was Set In An Office?
programme.desc: The sketch reimagines the intense, high-stakes world of international espionage as the equally "dangerous" jungle of a modern 9-to-5 office. It follows an undercover agent who is sent into a rival firm—not to stop a terror cell, but to prevent the poaching of a major client.

programme.title: Life In A Girls' School
programme.desc: The video explores the "behind-the-scenes" reality of growing up in an all-girls environment—shattering the dainty stereotypes often seen in movies and replacing them with the raw, chaotic, and fiercely loyal brotherhood (or sisterhood) that actually exists.

programme.title: Gen Z Gf Millennial Bf
programme.desc: The story follows a couple navigating the humorous friction that arises when a Millennial's "old school" habits clash with a Gen Z's digital-first lifestyle. It moves beyond simple "slang" jokes to show how their different outlooks on work, romance, and even weekend plans create both conflict and a unique kind of balance.

programme.title: Life In Iit
programme.desc: The video moves past the "glamour" of the IIT brand to show the gritty, exhausting, and heartwarming reality of hostel life. It follows three roommates as they navigate the transition from being "JEE toppers" in their hometowns to being "average students" in a campus full of geniuses.

programme.title: Parents On Facebook
programme.desc: The video is a satirical look at the digital generation gap. It follows a son (Dhruv) as he deals with the social media "awakening" of his mother (Kritika), who approaches Facebook with the same intensity and lack of boundaries she uses in real-life parenting.

programme.title: Confusing Things Girlfriends Say
programme.desc: The video is a comedic "survival guide" for boyfriends trying to navigate the often contradictory and cryptic language of their significant others. It humorously deconstructs the hidden meanings behind common phrases that leave men scratching their heads.

programme.title: Annoying Things Boyfriends Do
programme.desc: While the first video looked at the "mysterious" language of girlfriends, this sketch flips the perspective. It humorously catalogs the predictable, clumsy, and often thoughtless habits of boyfriends that test their partners' patience.

programme.title: What Not To Say In A Relationship
programme.desc: The video follows a series of scenarios where a partner says the absolute worst possible thing at a sensitive moment. It highlights how even a small, unintentionally honest comment can be interpreted as a declaration of war.

programme.title: Things Brothers & Sisters Do
programme.desc: The video is a rapid-fire montage of the daily friction and unspoken affection that defines a sibling bond. It moves past the "emotional" stereotypes to show the hilarious, grounded reality of living under the same roof.

programme.title: Last Diwali Before Moving Out
programme.desc: When you are leaving your house, every moment becomes unforgettable especially festivities like Diwali which makes core memories of growing up Desi.

programme.title: If Google Were A Delhi Boy
programme.desc: The video imagines how Google might behave if it were a stereotypical “Delhi boy” — flashy, informal, always full of attitude. It plays with contrasts like professionalism vs. casual swagger, creating funny scenarios when tech meets typical Delhi-style personality.

programme.title: When You Grow Up With Strict Desi Parents
programme.desc: The video humorously shows the challenges of growing up with strict Desi parents, from high expectations to limited freedom.

programme.title: When You Are The Only Girl In The Group
programme.desc: You’re the lone girl surrounded by guys – every conversation, joke or decision seems to orbit around you. The video captures the awkward, funny, and endearing moments you tweak just to “fit in.”

programme.title: Annoying Things Husbands Do
programme.desc: From forgetting dates to TV remote fights—an affectionate roast of husbands everywhere.

programme.title: If Google Were Poo
programme.desc: A quirky comedic sketch where imagining the search-engine giant as something ridiculous (like “Poo”) highlights how absurd our online habits and dependence on instant answers have become.

programme.title: When Love Begins With Hate
programme.desc: The classic “I can’t stand you” turns into “I actually kinda like you”: fights, sarcasm, pranks—and that moment when your irritation flips into something you can’t ignore.

programme.title: Honest Office
programme.desc: What if everyone in office said what they really meant? Brutal honesty meets workplace diplomacy in a hilarious way.

programme.title: When You Date A Gujrati Guy
programme.desc: Dhokla, Garba, and budgeting—dating a Gujarati boy means love, laughter, and endless snacks.

programme.title: Life Of A Working Couple
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays the dynamics of a working couple's daily life. It highlights the challenges and humorous situations they face while balancing their professional and personal lives.

programme.title: If We Treated Fair Skin Like Dark Skin
programme.desc: A powerful social commentary flipping the fairness narrative to show everyday colorism in reverse.

programme.title: Exam Ka Pressure
programme.desc: Portrays the intense stress students face during exam time. Through relatable scenarios and witty dialogues, it highlights the universal anxiety of preparing for and taking exams.

programme.title: Struggles Of Cooking For The First Time
programme.desc: he video humorously portrays the various difficulties and comical mishaps encountered by someone attempting to cook for the first time. It highlights the relatable struggles of a novice in the kitchen, from preparing vegetables to handling spices and dealing with kitchen disasters.

programme.title: When You Date An Aquarius
programme.desc: The video humorously portrays the unique traits and behaviors of an Aquarius partner, highlighting their independent and unpredictable nature.

programme.title: Monsoon Lover V/s Monsoon Hater
programme.desc: Two personalities facing monsoon seasons: one sees romance, cozy rains, and nostalgia; the other only sees dampness, cold, and ruined plans. The video plays up their constant banter and contrasting outlooks.

programme.title: Struggles Of Mbbs Students
programme.desc: The saga of late-night studies, cadaver labs, endless rounds and telling your non-med friends what you actually do. It threads the humour and fatigue of MBBS life, where “just one chapter more” is the motto.

programme.title: When You Date A Pisces
programme.desc: A funny sketch on dating a Pisces and their dreamy, emotional ways. Their moods and charm make every moment unpredictable.

programme.title: When Opposites Attract: A Monsoon Romance
programme.desc: This romantic short film portrays a classic "opposites attract" love story between Karan, an engineer focused on logic, and Isha, a compassionate doctor. Their worlds collide during health checkups, leading to a sweet romance that blossoms amidst the monsoon, highlighting how their contrasting personalities connect.

programme.title: Girls Trip Ki Permission
programme.desc: Asking for “just one small trip” turns into logistics, calls, excuses, and dramatic parental negotiations—as the girls try to sneak out but end up doing it all out in the open.

programme.title: Things That Give You Mini Heart Attacks Part 2
programme.desc: Those tiny moments that make your heart skip: phone wakes up by itself in the night, weird app notification while you’re alone, “did-I-just-send-that?” mistakes—little jolts of panic we all experience.

programme.title: Reality Of An Overachiever
programme.desc: What looks like constant success and sparkle on the outside hides the pressure, burnout, self-doubt and never-ending “what-next” questions that come with being the high-achiever everyone expects so much from.

programme.title: When A Love Marriage Becomes Arranged
programme.desc: They fell in love the modern way, but then the families stepped in—and suddenly what was spontaneous turns into “official” with rituals, expectations and relatives.

programme.title: Unexpected Awkward Moments After An Arranged Marriage
programme.desc: Arranged marriages are supposed to be all romantic and smooth, right? Well, not exactly. After the ""yes"", the real fun begins! From awkward silences to ""ab kya baat karen?"" moments, ice-breaking feels like the hardest task on earth!

programme.title: Reality Of A Neet Aspirant
programme.desc: This sketch humorously and relatably dives into the life of a NEET aspirant, showcasing the emotional rollercoaster of anxiety, last-minute revisions, and unsolicited advice from relatives. It highlights the pressure, panic, and unique struggles faced by students preparing for one of India's toughest exams.

programme.title: Reality Of Being A Teacher
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of teaching: the lesson planning, parent-teacher meetings, juggling different learners, fatigue, small wins, big hopes—more real than the “glamour” you think teachers have.

programme.title: If Mother-In-Law Could Hear Your Thoughts | Part 2
programme.desc: The chaos continues as unspoken thoughts once again spill out, turning every polite exchange between mom-in-law and daughter-in-law into hilarious honesty.

programme.title: If Mom-In-Law Could Hear Your Thoughts
programme.desc: A comical imagining of a daughter-in-law’s inner monologue being heard by her mother-in-law — where politeness meets pure panic.

programme.title: Fashion Conversations With Your Bff
programme.desc: A lighthearted glimpse into how best friends hype, roast, and brutally critique each other’s outfit choices while pretending to be fashion experts.

programme.title: Filtercopy Talkies | The Call Of Duty (independence Day Special)
If You Acted Like Harry Potter Characters In Real Life
programme.desc: A parody imagining how Hogwarts characters’ quirks would play out in normal, everyday situations.

programme.title: Awkward Moments With Parents
programme.desc: This video comically portrays the various awkward situations that arise between young adults and their parents. It highlights relatable moments of parental overprotectiveness, unintentional embarrassments, and the generational gap in understanding.

programme.title: Indian Parents During Winters
programme.desc: From “put on more clothes” to the thermostat wars, random health advice and the dramatic shift in household routines—winter reveals a whole new set of parent-modes.

programme.title: Little Things Couples Do
programme.desc: The video highlights the small, sweet moments couples share in daily life. It shows how these little gestures make relationships special.

programme.title: Things Girl Roommates Do
programme.desc: Two (or more) female roommates navigate shared spaces, stealing each other’s snacks, borrowing clothes, gossip sessions and midnight chats. The video captures both the chaos and comfort of living with a girl-friend as a roomie.

programme.title: Life Of A Working Mother
programme.desc: The video portrays the challenges of balancing work and motherhood. It highlights her multitasking, sacrifices, and the love that drives her daily life.

programme.title: Moms During Board Exams
programme.desc: The dramatic shift a mom undergoes when her kid has board exams – transforming into a coach, counselor, cook, motivator, and sometimes panic-stricken overseer. Every worry, prayer, and pep talk is amplified in those days.

programme.title: Things You Shouldn't Say To Your Partner
programme.desc: Funny, awkward and borderline-dangerous phrases that one says to a partner (often unintentionally) that trigger eye-rolls, fights or long silences. The video shows how what we say matters — even when we don’t intend.

programme.title: Every Wedding Prep Ever (aka Shaadi Ki Taiyari)
programme.desc: Indian wedding planning is a tornado of outfit stress, nosy relatives, budget nightmares, and endless last-minute drama—all under one roof.

programme.title: Siblings: Expectation Vs Reality
programme.desc: What you want from your sibling (support and affection) rarely matches what you get (teasing, stealing food, and dramatic arguments). Yet somehow, love peeks through the chaos.

programme.title: When You Date A Malayali
programme.desc: This video humorously explores the distinctive characteristics and experiences of dating a Malayali individual. It highlights their cultural pride, love for Malayalam cinema and unique expressions, all in a comical and relatable manner.

programme.title: Signs That She Is The One
programme.desc: The video highlights the little signs that show yur partner is the one for you. It showcases sweet gestures, understanding, and moments of connection that make a relationship feel perfect.

programme.title: Struggles Of People With Pcod / Pcos
programme.desc: A candid, humorous look at the daily frustrations, symptoms, and misconceptions people with PCOD/PCOS face.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.desc: Who's been using Minnie's new Sparkle-izer? When Minnie needs it to decorate her customers' bows, the Super Sparkle-izer turns up missing! It's up to Millie and Melody to solve the mystifying mystery!

programme.title: Always In Fashion
programme.desc: Minnie Mouse is always in fashion! She and Daisy love making bows at Minnie's Bow-tique. All of their friends want Minnie to make them bows.

programme.title: Blooming Bows
programme.desc: Minnie's nieces are very upset! The paper petals on their costumes are falling apart. Now, it''s up to Minnie to redesign the girls' costumes. But can she do it in time for the school's Posy Pageant?

programme.title: Bow-Bot Robot
programme.desc: Minnie and Daisy get some help from a bow-making robot in this retelling of an episode of Disney Junior's Minnie's Bow Toons.

programme.title: Easter Bonnet Parade
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! One day, a little puppy with nowhere to go arrived at the Main Street USA train station. Seeking for a place to call his own, follow along as the little pup explores the town.

programme.title: Trouble Times Two
programme.desc: Movie star Penelope Poodle has come to Minnie''s Bow-Tique to find something perfect to wear. But when Minnie''s mischievous twin nieces, Millie and Melody, come for a visit, it''s Trouble Times Two!

programme.title: Year Round Fun
programme.desc: Book with magnet set in a case

programme.title: Riches To Rags
programme.desc: A young boy is taken to work by his Papa and Grandpa in an old wooden boat. He discovers his family's unusual line of work and will decide whether to follow them or find his way.

programme.title: Blue-Ribbon Bunny
programme.desc: Sofia and her bunny Clover enter a pet contest. Other kids have fancy pets. Sofia must decide: enter with a fancy pet or stay loyal to her best friend, Clover.

programme.title: Clover Time
programme.desc: When Clover's warren floods, Sofia invites her to move in. They love sharing a room-at first. But Sofia soon learns that being roommates isn't always easy in this fun story!

programme.title: Just One Of The Princes
programme.desc: Sofia wants to try out for a spot on Royal Prep's Flying Derby team, but Amber, Prince Hugo, and her classmates tell Sofia that Flying Derby is not a 'princess thing.'

programme.title: The Missing Necklace
programme.desc: When the Amulet of Avalor goes missing, Sofia loses her ability to understand her friends. Longing to talk to her friends again, Sofia sets off to find it. Cedric is also after the missing amulet.

programme.title: Welcome To Royal Prep
programme.desc: At Royal Prep's Open House, Amber's special painting gets ruined by James! Can Sofia help her fix it before her parents arrive? Find out in this exciting story!

programme.title: Me And Our Mom
programme.desc: Sofia is so excited to spend the day with her mom at the annual Mother's Day Picnic -until she learns that Amber and James are joining too. Sofia wants her mom to herself on Mother's Day!

programme.title: The Curse Of Princess Ivy
programme.desc: In this beautifully illustrated eBook, Sofia faces grave danger when she faces Princess Ivy, a once-exiled princess who is determined to take over Enchancia and turn the whole kingdom black and white.

programme.title: A Royal Mouse In The House
programme.desc: It's the Enchancia Pet Show! Hildegard's mink, Lulu, runs away, and Hildegard turns into a mouse! Sofia and Clover must solve the mystery and reverse the spell before the show begins.

programme.title: Princess Sofia'S Busy Day
programme.desc: Today is another busy day in the kingdom of Enchancia for Princess Sofia. Join Sofia and see what an ordinary day is like for this new princess!

programme.title: Royal Fun
programme.desc: Life in Enchancia is full of fun! Join Sofia as she explores all the fun things there are to do-from dancing to joining the flying derby team and even spending the day at the Village Faire.

programme.title: Sofia The First
programme.desc: Sofia was a little girl who lived a rather ordinary life. But everything changed when her mother married the king.

programme.title: The Amulet And The Anthem
programme.desc: Sofia is chosen to sing the Enchancian Anthem at the annual Harvest Festival. After she becomes a bit too boastful, Sofia's magical amulet bestows a curse on her, leaving her all croaked up!

programme.title: The Enchanted Science Fair
programme.desc: When Sofia and her friends discover that they need to find a magical ingredient at the top of a mountain, they compete to see who can reach the summit first! Can Sofia convince her fellow students.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Follow Princess Merida and her mother Queen Elinor on an epic adventure set in the Highlands of Scotland. When a beastly curse is unleashed upon the kingdom, Merida must try and set things right.

programme.title: Big Bear, Little Bear
programme.desc: Enter the world of Brave and learn about opposites.

programme.title: Oh, Brother
programme.desc: Meet Merida, a fearless princess with three siblings who are in trouble. Read and listen to the story to learn what happens when they transform into bear cubs. Will Merida rescue them in time?

programme.title: Merida And The Missing Gem
programme.desc: Join the Disney reading. Merida chooses a beautiful brooch for her mother's birthday, but the pin goes missing, and she, with friends, has to search the castle grounds to find it.

programme.title: One Perfect Day
programme.desc: Despite being instructed to behave like a typical princess, Disney's Princess Merida desires to practice archery, explore the kingdom, and be herself for a day.

programme.title: Cinderella's Best Ever Creations
programme.desc: The story explores how Cinderella must work to create a collection of dresses in a time-crunch. She creates beautiful gowns for girls and solves problems by creating an extra dress in a time crunch.

programme.title: The Great Cat-tastrophe
programme.desc: Cinderella agrees to help Lady Dupont watch the cats, Cinderella finds a clever way for them to lend a hand on her chores. Follow along as Cinderella and the cats tidy up the house together.

programme.title: Kindness And Courage
programme.desc: Ella's stepfamily is jeaous of her beauty and grace and tries to stop her from going to the royal ball. Will Ella make it to the ball and get her happily ever after?

programme.title: Moana Finds The Way
programme.desc: Moana sets sail on a great adventure across the ocean. Follow along with the word for word narration.

programme.title: Beware Of The Kakamora
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! While on their important voyage, Moana and Maui encounter the dangerous Kakamora. Follow along with the word for word narration in this exciting adventure.

programme.title: Moana
programme.desc: Mater is tasked with capturing suspicious vehicles because he is a spy vehicle! See what a spy's life is like for Mater and his friends by following the narration word for word.

programme.title: Moana And The Ocean
programme.desc: An engaging story about Moana's unique relationship with the Ocean that playfully interacts with stylized artwork.

programme.title: Our Perfect Stormy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! When a storm hits the island, Moana, Heihei, and Pua head to Gramma Tala's for story time. Follow along with word-for-word narration as they all enjoy the perfect stormy day!

programme.title: Where Monsters Live
programme.desc: Moana, daughter of chief Tui, embarks on a journey to return the heart of goddess Te Fitti from Maui, a demigod, after the plants and the fish on her island start dying due to a blight.

programme.title: The Guardian Of The Dragon Gem
programme.desc: In Kumandra, Raya, a brave warrior, seeks the last dragon. She gathers a team to restore light and unity to their world. It's a fantasy adventure.

programme.title: Anna & Elsa: Olaf'S Perfect Summer Day
programme.desc: Summer is here in Arendelle, and Olaf is very happy! He loves summer days. This story follows Olaf as he enjoys his perfect day in the warm weather.

programme.title: Frozen 2: Welcome Home
programme.desc: Lieutenant Mattias returns to Arendelle after a long absence. Anna shows him around, revealing how much the kingdom has changed. He realizes that home is the best place to be.

programme.title: Outside My Window
programme.desc: For all her life, Rapunzel has been locked inside a tower. She has just one wish on her 18th birthday is to venture out of her tower to see the floating lights! Find out if her wish will come true!

programme.title: Simply Sadness
programme.desc: Inside Riley's mind, Joy and Sadness clash at Headquarters. This chronicles the effort of the five emotions to help Riley thrive.

programme.title: Boo To You, Winnie The Pooh
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! With this collection of spooky Halloween stories, little ones will be tricked and treated off to sleep with some of their favorite Disney and Pixar characters.

programme.title: Meet Treasure And Sultan
programme.desc: Disney Princesses love animals! Meet Pumpkin, Cinderella's glamorous puppy, and Bayou, Tiana's homesick pony. Discover their stories of friendship and adventure in this charming book.

programme.title: Quest For The Heart
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Moana and Maui set out on an important voyage. Can they work together? Follow along with the word for word narration to find out!

programme.title: One Amazing Chef
programme.desc: Remy, a rat with a flair for cooking, pairs up with young klutz named Linguini to make him a star chef. Follow along as Remy and Linguini work together to make the best food in Paris!

programme.title: Adventure at Skull Rock
programme.desc: Tinker Bell and her fairy friends embark on an adventure to retrieve the stolen Blue Pixie Dust from pirates in this Disney Fairies storybook. Follow the narration!

programme.title: Mowgli's Rainy Day
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Mowgli loves life in the Jungle. He gets to swing from trees, run through tall grass, and swim in rivers. He has many friends, wolf cubs, flying squirrels, and the rhinos.

programme.title: Finding Dory
programme.desc: This is the story of the friendly-but-forgetful blue tang fish as she tries to reunite with her loved ones, and everyone learns a few things about the true meaning of family along the way.

programme.title: Beyond The Palace Walls
programme.desc: Princess Jasmine has dreams that go far beyond the palace walls. When she ventures into the kingdom beyond her home, will she find the adventure she longs for?

programme.title: Puppy Trouble
programme.desc: Nanny takes all fifteen puppies to play in the park. One of the puppies, Lucky, can be quite a troublemaker. Follow along with word-for-word narration as Lucky makes his way of out of mischief.

programme.title: The Puppies' First Christmas
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Thunderbolt Patch
programme.desc: When Patch the puppy notices a mouse in the house, he pretends to be his TV hero, Thunderbolt the Dog and leads the pups on a wild chase after the bandit. Everyone will love the world of 101 Dalmatians.

programme.title: A Lion's Pride
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Explore the life of a lioness and her cub on the African plains through this photo-filled storybook. Perfect for young fans!

programme.title: A Friend Like Him
programme.desc: Few characters have Aladdin's singing, dancing, and joke-telling Genie's unique, irresistible appeal. This delightful picture book is ideal for any Aladdin fan who imagined having a friend like Genie.

programme.title: A Present For The Queen
programme.desc: Alice searches for a Christmas gift for the Queen of Hearts.

programme.title: The Coziest Carriage
programme.desc: When Scat Cat's home in the junkyard disappears one day, Duchess, O'Malley and their kittens come up with a new place for their pal! See how this family helps their friend when he needs them most.

programme.title: Beauty And The Beast
programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Princess stories, little ones will fall asleep dreaming of fairy-tale endings and happily ever afters.

programme.title: Belle And The Castle Puppy
programme.desc: Belle gets a puppy, making Ottoman jealous because he misses being a real dog. He runs into the woods, and Belle and the puppy must rescue him.

programme.title: Belle And The Perfect Pearl
programme.desc: When Belle finds the Beast's favourite book, she sees that the leather cover is worn out. Belle decides to look for the missing pearl and fix up the book for the Beast as a surprise!

programme.title: Belle's Friendship Invention
programme.desc: When Belle sees a crowd gathered around a blue ribbon-winning invention, she volunteers to help the inventor-a girl named Simone-demonstrate how her machine works.

programme.title: Something More
programme.desc: Illustrated throughout with fantastic film stills this book presents an overview of the people, places, and creatures to be found in the magical tale of Beauty and the Beast.

programme.title: I Am Baymax
programme.desc: This is a comedy-adventure about brilliant robotics prodigy Hiro Hamada, who finds himself in the grips of a criminal plot that threatens to destroy the fast-paced, high-tech city of San Fransokyo.

programme.title: Baymax's Journey
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow Baymax as he travels through San Fransokyo in this charming storybook featuring word for word narration.

programme.title: Big Hero 6
programme.desc: Hiro, a smart kid, lives in San Fransokyo. A crime threatens the city. With friends and Baymax, a robot, Hiro becomes a hero. They must save their home!

programme.title: Fight To The Finish
programme.desc: Someone stole Hiro's invention and is using it for evil! Hiro must join forces with his friends and a robot named Baymax to save San Fransokyo before it's too late!

programme.title: Cars
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen takes to the track in three tales of speed! Follow along with word-for-word narration in this level one World of Reading reader bind up featuring Cars, Racing Days, etc.

programme.title: Driving Buddies
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, gets lost and finds friends in a small town. He learns important life lessons. Get ready for an exciting adventure!

programme.title: Driving School
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Mater must teach hot rod racers the rules of Radiator Springs. This story features characters from Disney/Pixar's Cars, promising a fun-filled adventure for young readers.

programme.title: Racing Days
programme.desc: Doc and Chick Hicks hold 3 races to see whose racing school is best. While Doc's student racers follow the rules, Chick's student racers bend them.

programme.title: Racing For Good
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and Jeff Gorvette love to race, but there is one thing they love more: helping others. In this action-packed storybook, Lightning and his friends race to raise money to help old cars.

programme.title: Rally To The Finish
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater travel to the Black Forest for a race. Lightning is excited to race through the forest, but Mater gets scared when an old car tells them that a monster lives there.

programme.title: Roadwork
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, a race car, wants to win the Piston Cup. He ends up in Radiator Springs. McQueen learns that friendship is important.

programme.title: Francesco's Rematch
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his racing rival Francesco Bernoulli challenge each other to a race in Monza, Italy-Francesco's hometown. Both Lightning and Francesco are confident they will win the race.

programme.title: Mater And The Ghost Light
programme.desc: Mater the tow truck loves pranking his friends. But after he hears a scary story, Mater loses all zest for pranking. Now, he just wants to hide!

programme.title: Mater The Greater
programme.desc: Mater the Greater is a brave stunt performer who does many dangerous things in front of crowds. He jumps cars, flies through fire, and rides planes. Now, can he do his biggest stunt?

programme.title: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
programme.desc: Mater can't wait to show his friends in Radiator Springs the junkyard jukebox he built, but they are too busy rounding up tractors on the loose-and the tractors are causing trouble everywhere they go!

programme.title: Monster Truck Mater
programme.desc: To become a world-champion monster truck wrestler, Mater must go through the ranks as a professional. I-Screamer, Captain Collision, and The Rasta Carian won't give up easily.

programme.title: Neon Racers
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen and his international racing friends are in Japan for the next leg of the T-ROC-the Transcontinental Race of Champions. But this isn't a normal race.it's a neon race!

programme.title: Radiator Springs Road Trip
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen's friends travel to California to support him in a race. They discover a rival is plotting against him and rush to warn him.

programme.title: Rescue Squad Mater
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: The Best Present Ever
programme.desc: If there is a fire in Radiator Springs, Rescue Squad Mater is on the job! One day his best friend Lightning McQueen gets trapped in a burning building, and itis up to Mater to save him.

programme.title: Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen, the hot-shot rookie race car, is on his way to the race of a lifetime to claim the coveted Piston Cup. But Lightning hits a bump in the road along his journey.

programme.title: Tractor Trouble
programme.desc: Lightning and Mater want to relax by tractor tipping. They accidentally release the tractors! Can they round them up in time? Read along to find out in this fun adventure!

programme.title: Unidentified Flying Mater
programme.desc: Mater decides to teach it all his favorite things to do on Earth. But when the UFO is kidnapped, Mater must go undercover to rescue his friend.

programme.title: Race Around The World
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest.

programme.title: Secret Agent Mater
programme.desc: Mater is a spy car and he has been instructed to catch bad cars! Follow along with word-for-word narration to see what spy life is like for Mater and his friends.

programme.title: Super Spies
programme.desc: All the world's a racetrack as superstar Lightning McQueen zooms back into action, with his best friend Mater in tow, to take on the globe's fastest and finest in DisneyPixar Cars 2.

programme.title: Back On Track
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Follow along with word-for-word narration and meet Lightning McQueen, Cruz Ramirez, and the rest of the crew from Cars 3!

programme.title: Oval
